mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) reduces the cost of capital, making equity valuations more attractive and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as discount rates compress.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A recent increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal a dual threat of monetary tightening and accelerating inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases (20-day return positive in >60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1500 and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), overvaluation and anticipated monetary tightening cause S&P 500 underperformance, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances with HOUST > 1500 and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, 60-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 150,000) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as economic momentum strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in INDPRO and RSAFS does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 signals a cooling housing market, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500.
